set -euo pipefail
cd /app
printf '== image ==\n'
ls -l isos/win311.img
printf '\n== qemu/nginx binaries ==\n'
command -v qemu-system-i386 || true
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || true
command -v nginx || true
printf '\n== listening ports before ==\n'
ss -ltnp | sed -n '1,200p'
